question: Does y act as the carry/wrap amount in floor((x.y/p)*N) vs floor((x/p)*N)?

mechanism.under_p: floor((x.y / p) * p) = floor(x.y) = x — tail invisible to p-floor
mechanism.under_N: tail can push floor from A to A+1

confound.note: weak n correlation expected; carry is point-specific not index-driven

admissible_fact.statement: x.y is not merely a display packet. When projected from p to N: x sets the floor; y decides whether the projected floor stays A or carries to A+1.

ruling: Admissible fact, not conviction. y-tail carry is structural, not scalar identity.
judge_popcorn: Admissible fact, not conviction. x is the floor; y is the pressure; N hears the carry.
